description: Ministry of Public Service, PC & LG - 5th Amendment to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Planning Service
reasoning: This gazette content focuses exclusively on amendments to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Planning Service, detailing salary scales, recruitment methods, promotion criteria, and service conditions for public sector employees. It involves public service administration, salary revisions, and recruitment/promotion procedures, which aligns perfectly with Public Service Gazettes (Type 8). There are no government personnel appointments, structural changes, or specialized content related to land, legal, commercial, elections, or judicial matters.
